therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: angiogenesis inhibition and tumor cell adhesion disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: recurrent and/or metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck

results.effect_size: HR 1.03 (95% CI: 0.67-1.59) for once weekly vs control; HR 1.55 (95% CI: 0.99-2.43) for twice weekly vs control
results.dose_information: Cilengitide 2000 mg once weekly or twice weekly IV infusion over 60 minutes, combined with cetuximab 250 mg/m2 weekly, 5-FU 1000 mg/m2 daily days 1-4, and cisplatin 100 mg/m2 day 1 of each 3-week cycle

context.duration: 6 cycles (18 weeks) followed by maintenance until progression
